title: Private Raku Firings
source_quote: A private Raku session for you or a group. Starting at $1,000 per private firing
evidence_sentence: Private raku firings can be arranged for individuals or groups; studio sets up, conducts, and cleans up the firing.
evidence_quote: A private firing, just for you. A private Raku session for you or a group.
summary: Private raku firing rental starting at $1,000, including two raku guides, all glazes, equipment, gas, and setup/cleanup. Participants bring bisque-fired work ready to glaze.
